relations.subject: Debiprasad Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: Debiprasad Chattopadhyaya obtained his academic training in philosophy in Calcutta, West Bengal under eminent philosophers like Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan and S. N. Dasgupta.

relations.subject: Debiprasad Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: he did his post-graduate research work under Prof S. N. Dasgupta.

relations.subject: Debiprasad Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: standing first in philosophy at University of Calcutta both in B.A. (1939) and M.A. (1942)

relations.subject: Debiprasad Chattopadhyaya

relations.subject: Debiprasad Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: His second wife was the renowned educationist and Tibetologist, Dr. Alaka Majumder Chattopadhyaya (1926–1998).

relations.subject: Debiprasad Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: He collaborated with some of the outstanding western scholars of the 20th century, like Joseph Needham, George Thomson, Bongard Levin and Walter Ruben.
